highlights: By Hour price ignores the number of hours (1 h = 24 h); priced as a Transfer distance band (Q-15).
Multi-day: today is always added and cannot be removed; Late Allowance is charged per calendar day of the span (₹14,000 / ₹27,000 on daytime trips).
By Hour rejects Munnar, Panaji and Chennai with 'location is required' although Point To Point accepts them.
Submitted inquiry ORZS120376 is stored as 'Transfer' without the hours; timings 00:00.
Second vehicle replaces the first (60 passengers).
Hours validation: browser-only messages; blank shows a raw NaN error.
Persistence (tab switching, Modify hours, remove date, drop OFF) works; Multi-day OFF resets the trip to today.

issues.title: Submitted By Hour inquiry stores no hours and timings 00:00 / 00:00; it is saved as a plain 'Transfer'
issues.where: Dashboard → My Inquiries → Edit Inquiry (inquiry details)
steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Transfer → By Hour.
Pickup Whitefield, drop OFF, 25 Nov 2026 10:00 AM, 4 hours, 40 passengers, 40 Seater Premium AC Coach → Confirm & Submit.
Dashboard → My Inquiries → ORZS120376 → Edit Inquiry.
issues.expected: Inquiry shows the By Hour type, 4 hours and 10:00 AM pickup (Q-30).
issues.actual: Type 'Transfer'; Booking Type 'Transfer'; 'Timings: Arrival: 00:00 | Departure: 00:00'; drop = pickup Whitefield; no field or text with the 4 hours. Confirm screen also shows no hours. Same timing defect as the P2P/Return run (P2P-02-Issue-01).
issues.impact: Admin cannot see how many hours the customer booked or when the vehicle is needed.

issues.actual: 'numberOfHours must be a `number` type, but the final value was: `NaN` (cast from the value `""`).' Recurrence of Local TC-06-Issue-01.

issues.title: Hours 0, −1, 25 and 100 blocked only by the browser tooltip; no in-app message

steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Transfer → By Hour.

issues.title: By Hour fare does not depend on the number of hours (1 h = 24 h = ₹15,000 base)
steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Transfer → By Hour.
Peenya, drop OFF, 2 Dec 2026 6:00 AM, 10 passengers, 28 Seater Premium AC Coach.
Repeat with hours 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 23, 24.
issues.expected: Per Q-15 (the workbook expects hourly pricing; Local uses packages + extra hour).
issues.actual: Vehicle Base Cost ₹15,000 for every value; only 24 h adds Late Allowance ₹2,000 (ends 06:00 next day). The breakup shows a distance band, no hourly or km line. Same in HRS-06 (Hyderabad 4 h vs 24 h base ₹35,000) and HRS-11 (10 h → 12 h unchanged).
issues.impact: If By Hour is meant to be priced by hours, every quote is wrong (same pattern as Local TC-07-Issue-01).

issues.title: By Hour rejects some out-of-state places (Munnar, Panaji, Chennai) with 'Drop/Pickup location is required' while Point To Point accepts them
issues.where: Transfer → By Hour → Pickup / Drop Location
steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Transfer → By Hour.
Drop at different location ON; Pickup Whitefield; Drop: choose 'Munnar, Keralam, India' from the suggestions; Hours 2 → Book Now!.
Repeat with drop 'Panaji, Goa, India' or pickup 'Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India'.
Compare: Transfer → Point To Point, Whitefield → Munnar.
issues.expected: Same location scope as Point To Point (T-10), or a clear message that the place is outside the service area.
issues.actual: The selected place stays in the field but 'Drop location is required' (Munnar – both suggestions, Panaji, Chennai) or 'Pickup location is required' (Chennai). Hyderabad (Telangana) and Mysuru are accepted. Point To Point accepts Whitefield → Munnar.
issues.impact: Customers cannot book By Hour trips to or from several destinations and are told the field is empty.

issues.title: Multi-day: today is always selected and cannot be removed (past time accepted, zero dates impossible)
issues.where: By Hour → Multi-day Trip → Select Travel Dates (chips)
steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Transfer → By Hour.
Turn Multi-day Trip ON (chip 'Nov 18, 2026' appears).
Select 21 Nov, 23 Nov, 1 Dec; then remove every chip with ×.
Book Now!.
issues.expected: Only the dates the user selects; zero dates blocks the search (H-05).
issues.actual: 'Nov 18, 2026' (today) remains after removing all chips and is always included; the search ran for today at 08:00 (already past). In HRS-13 the 07:00 slot was disabled because today is included, so the pickup time stayed at the current time (7:19 PM). Recurrence of Local TC-06-Issue-04.
issues.impact: Every multi-day By Hour quote includes an unwanted day, often in the past.

evidence.caption: All chips removed: search still runs with today

clarifications: Q-15 By Hour pricing model: distance band vs hours; Local uses 8 Hr/80 Km packages.
Q-16 far drop vs booked hours (Hyderabad in 4 h priced ₹35,000).
Q-17 multi-day pricing: per selected date or per calendar span (Late Allowance uses the span).
Q-09 late window: 04:00 start has no Late Allowance.
Q-33 multi-day + different drop: which day the drop applies to.
Q-11 / T-10 By Hour location scope vs Point To Point.
Q-21 drop equal to pickup accepted.
Q-30 inquiry details: By Hour type and hours are not stored/shown.
scope: Executed: all 14 By Hours use cases of the v3.2 workbook; results graded per case (Pass/Fail/Partial/Inconclusive).
Fare verdicts follow .claude/shared/fare-verification.md; amounts depending on unconfirmed rules are 'Inconclusive', never assumed.
HRS-04 priced a representative hour set (1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 23, 24) instead of all 24 values, by user decision, to limit run time on a memory-constrained machine.
Environment: the machine ran low on memory; the test browser was stopped once and HRS-04 was re-run from the start.

Redesigned Preprod home page (since 18 Nov ~15:20): an overlay intermittently swallows clicks on tabs and toggles; the automation uses DOM clicks and one retry. The HRS-06 Munnar/Goa rejection was confirmed independently (the P2P control accepts the same place).
Workbook data note: HRS-11 uses 8 passengers on a 7-seat MPV (capacity popup expected).
Evidence: screenshots mask phone numbers, e-mail and the account name. Local, Outstation and Transfer P2P/Return reports untouched.
